heading: SCOPE
description: This standard specifies installation requirements of interior and exterior rear view mirrors in Automotive vehicles.

heading: REFERENCES
description: The definitions given in AIS 001 shall apply.

heading: REFERENCES
description: 'Type of vehicle in respect of rear view mirrors' means motor vehicles do not differ among themselves in respect of the specifications given in Annex I.

heading: TYPE APPROVAL
description: Application for Type Approval

heading: TYPE APPROVAL
description: The vehicle manufacturer shall submit following information for type approval of a vehicle: Technical specifications of vehicle and mirror which shall include at least the details given in Annex 1.

heading: TYPE APPROVAL
description: Modifications/changes in technical specification.

heading: TYPE APPROVAL
description: Every functional modification in technical specifications pertaining to installation of rear view mirror declared in accordance with 3.1, shall be intimated to the testing agency. Testing agency may then consider, whether;

heading: TYPE APPROVAL
description: Vehicle with modifications complies with specified requirements, or,

heading: TYPE APPROVAL
description: any testing is required.

heading: TYPE APPROVAL
description: For considering whether testing is required or not, guidelines given in Annex 2 shall be followed.

heading: TYPE APPROVAL
description: In case of 3.2.1.2, checks for those parameters which are affected by the modifications only need to be carried out.

heading: TYPE APPROVAL
description: In the event of 3.2.1.1. or in the case of 3.2.1.2 after successful compliance to requirements, the certificate of compliance shall be validated for the modified version.

heading: TYPE APPROVAL
description: These conditions are applicable irrespective of any change in commercial name of the model.

heading: GENERAL REQUIREMENTS
description: Rear-view mirrors shall be complying with the requirements of AIS No 001 from the date notified and shall be fitted in such a way that the mirror does not move significantly to change the field of vision as measured or vibrate to an extent which would cause the driver to misinterpret the nature of the image perceived.

heading: GENERAL REQUIREMENTS
description: The adjusted position of mirror shall remain substantially unchanged after vehicle is driven at speeds of up to 80% of its maximum design speed, but not exceeding 150 km/h, for about 10 minutes time, on test track or highways.

heading: GENERAL REQUIREMENTS
description: If the interior rear view mirror does not provide any rearward vision, its presence is not mandatory. However, such a fitment is allowed even if it gives partial rearward vision, provided all other vision requirements are met.

heading: GENERAL REQUIREMENTS
description: In case of 2 wheelers with engine capacity upto 70cc, one mirror on right side and for other 2 wheelers and unbodied 3 wheelers, two mirrors, one on right side and another on left side, shall be fitted or set in such a way that the center of the reflecting surface is at least 280 mm towards the outside of the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle. Before the measurement, the handlebars must remain in the position corresponding to the vehicle's traveling in a straight line and the rear view mirror(s) shall be set in their normal position of use. In case of 2 wheelers with engine capacity not exceeding 70cc, additional mirror on left side may be optionally fitted.

heading: GENERAL REQUIREMENTS
description: In the case of mirrors fitted on 2 and 3 wheelers (Class VI), mirrors shall comply with the dimensional requirements of clause 6.5 of AIS 001.

heading: FIELD OF VISION REQUIREMENTS
subheading: Vehicle completely built by the vehicle manufacturer
description: Vehicle Completely built by the vehicle manufacturer: In case of completely built vehicles and in the case of incompletely built vehicles (Drive away Chassis), where the rear view mirror is a part of the fitment by the vehicle manufacturer, the field of vision requirements for vehicles with body as mentioned below shall be fulfilled by fitment of suitable class and number of rear view mirrors. Class of vehicle, 1 = Field of vision requirements. Class of vehicle, 2 = Field of vision requirements. Class of vehicle, 1 = Mandatory. Class of vehicle, 2 = Additional Options. N1 with GVW not exceeding 2 T, M1 and L7, 1 = (F2 + F1) or (F2 + F3). N1 with GVW not exceeding 2 T, M1 and L7, 2 = F3 or F1. N 1 with GVW > 2t, 1 = (F2 + F1) or (F2 + F4). N 1 with GVW > 2t, 2 = F3 or F1. M 2, 1 = (F2 + F4). M 2, 2 = F5 and (F6 or F7 * ). N 2 with GVW not exceeding 7.5t, 1 = (F2 + F4) or F5 (F5 is mandatory if F4 is not achieved by convex mirrors). N 2 with GVW not exceeding 7.5t, 2 = F1 and (F6 or F7 * ). N 2 with GVW > 7.5t, 1 = (F2 + F4 + F5). N 2 with GVW > 7.5t, 2 = F1 and (F6 or F7 * ). M 3, 1 = (F2 + F4). M 3, 2 = F5 and (F6 or F7 * ). N 3, 1 = (F2 + F4 + F5) and (F6 or F7*). N 3, 2 = F1. 3WH with body, 1 = (F2 + F3). 3WH with body, 2 = F1 Amendment No. 1 dated 18 May 2015 substitutes the third row of the clause 5.1 table: class of vehicle N1 with GVW not exceeding 2 T, M1 and L7; mandatory field of vision (F2 + F1) or (F2 + F3); additional options F3 or F1.

heading: FIELD OF VISION REQUIREMENTS
description: Incomplete vehicles (Drive-away Chassis):

heading: FIELD OF VISION REQUIREMENTS
description: In case of incompletely built vehicles (Drive away Chassis), where the rear view mirror is not a part of the fitment by the vehicle manufacturer, the sizes of mirror shall be as follows: M2 , N2, Mirror Size = 130 mm W X 240 mm H. M3, N3, Mirror Size = Upper size 183 mm W X 315 mm H Lower Size 183 mm W X 122 mm H The lower mirror would have a wider angle vision than the upper mirror. 3 Wheelers, Mirror Size = Equivalent to circle of 110 mm diameter.

heading: FIELD OF VISION REQUIREMENTS
description: In such cases, verification would not have been carried out at the time of type approval, as the fitment of mirror would be fitted only at the time of bodybuilding. This shall be indicated in the certificate and is to be verified by the registering authority.

heading: POSITION
description: Rear view mirrors shall be so placed that the driver, when sitting on the driving seat, in a normal driving position, has a clear view of the road to the rear and side(s) of the vehicle.

heading: POSITION
description: Exterior rear-view mirrors shall be visible through side windows or through the portion of the windscreen that is swept by the windscreen wiper, nevertheless, for design reasons visibility through wiped area shall not apply to exterior rear-view mirrors fitted on left side of vehicles of categories M2 and M3 and visible

heading: POSITION
description: In the case of any vehicle which is in chassis/cab form when the field of vision is measured, the minimum and maximum body widths shall be stated by the manufacturer and, if necessary, simulated by dummy headboards. All vehicles and mirror configurations taken into consideration during the tests shall be shown on the test report.

heading: POSITION
description: The prescribed exterior rear-view mirror on the driver's side of the vehicles shall be so located that an angle of not more than 55° is formed between the vertical longitudinal median plane of the vehicle and the vertical plane passing through the center of rear-view mirror and through the center of the straight line 65mm long which joins the driver's two ocular points (See figure a). This condition shall deemed to have met if the vehicle manufacturer certifies so.

heading: POSITION
description: Rear-view mirrors shall not project beyond the exterior bodywork of the vehicle substantially more than necessary to comply with the field of vision requirements.

heading: POSITION
description: Where the lower edge of an exterior rear-view mirror is less than 2 m above the ground when the vehicle is loaded to its maximum permissible weight (GVW), this rear-view mirror shall not project more than 0.20 m beyond the overall width of the vehicles measured without rear-view mirrors. Figure a

heading: POSITION
description: In case of vehicle satisfying field of view requirement of F6 or F7, rear view mirrors shall be mounted on vehicles in such a way that, regardless of their position after adjustment, no part of these mirrors or their holders is less than 2 m from the ground when the vehicle is under a load corresponding to its maximum permissible weight (GVW). These rear-view mirrors shall not, however, be mounted on vehicles, the cab height of which, is such as to prevent compliance with this requirement.

heading: POSITION
description: Subject to the requirements of items 6.5, 6.6 and 6.7 rear-view mirrors may project beyond the permissible maximum width of vehicle.

heading: ADJUSTMENT
description: The interior rear-view mirror shall be capable of being adjusted by the driver from his driving position.

heading: ADJUSTMENT
description: The exterior rear-view mirror situated on the driver's side shall be capable of being adjusted from inside the vehicle while the door is closed although the window may be open. The mirror may, however, be locked in position from the outside.

heading: ADJUSTMENT
description: The requirements of item 7.2 do not apply to exterior rear-view mirrors, which, after having been knocked out of alignment, can be returned to their former position without the need of adjustment.

heading: FIELDS OF VISION
description: The fields of vision have been defined in clause 5 of this standard. A tolerance of ± 10 % shall apply on all dimensions.

heading: FIELDS OF VISION
description: The fields of vision defined in clause 5 shall apply in respect of Ambinocular vision, the eyes being at the driver's ocular points. The fields of vision shall be determined when the vehicle is in running order (includes vehicle in kerb weight condition and driver of weight 75 ± 5 kg ). In case of vehicle other than 2 or 3 wheelers, the vehicle shall carry in addition one front seat passenger, the mass of the passenger being 75 ± 5 kg.. The field of vision shall be established through windows which have a total light transmission factor of at least 70% measured perpendicularly to the surface.

heading: FIELDS OF VISION
description: In the case of rear-view mirrors consisting of several reflecting surfaces which are either of different curvature or make an angle with each other on the reflecting surfaces, the combinations (see item 6.2.2 of AIS 001) shall provide the field of vision specified for the class of which they belong.

heading: FIELDS OF VISION
description: A reduction in the field of vision due to the presence of devices such as head restraints, parts of body work, sun visors, rear window wipers and heating elements etc,, is permissible provided that all these devices together do not obscure more than 15% of the specified field of vision.

heading: FIELDS OF VISION
description: The degree of obstruction is measured with the headrests adjusted to their lowest possible position and with the sun visors folded back.

heading: FIELDS OF VISION
description: In the fields of vision specified above, obstruction due to the bodywork components, such as door handles, outline marker lights, direction indicators and the extremities of rear bumpers, as well as reflective surface cleaning components etc, shall not be taken into account if they are responsible for a total obstruction of less than 10% of the specified field of vision.

heading: FIELDS OF VISION
description: The field of vision shall be determined by placing powerful light sources at the ocular points and examining the light reflected on the vertical monitoring screen. Other equivalent methods may be used.
